title: Retrofitting Unbounded Context onto Stock Language Models
summary: The paper reports that precise, query-targeted retrieval can recover far-context descriptions at million-token scale in tested stock language models, while residency or positional placement alone was insufficient.
ai_technology: Attention re-rotation and dynamically constructed far-context windows

evidence.tested: The paper reports that precise, query-targeted retrieval can recover far-context descriptions at million-token scale in tested stock language models, while residency or positional placement alone was insufficient.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to tested models, tasks and retrieval setups; the approach modifies attention context at inference.
